_about: Narration for the 240-second pitch film. `text` is what appears in subtitles and the script; `say` is the spelling the synthetic voice needs (SPHEREx as 'Sphere X', Tombaugh as 'Tombaw'). `at` is the start time in seconds on the film's timeline. Edit a line, then run `make -C film voice mix render`.

lines.text: In 2025, NASA launched SPHEREx.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, NASA launched Sphere X.

lines.text: Every six months, it maps the entire sky in 102 colours of infrared light.
lines.say: Every six months, it maps the entire sky, in a hundred and two colours of infrared light.

lines.text: Again. And again.
lines.say: Again. And again.

lines.text: And we couldn't stop asking: what if something important is hiding in there?
lines.say: And we couldn't stop asking... what if something important is hiding in there?

lines.text: We're a team from Bangladesh. And we built SPHEREx Explorer because we believe discovery shouldn't belong only to the people who have the tools to look for it.
lines.say: We're a team from Bangladesh. And we built Sphere X Explorer because we believe discovery shouldn't belong only to the people who have the tools to look for it.

lines.text: Arizona, 1930. Clyde Tombaugh blinks between two photographs of the same patch of sky…
lines.say: Arizona, nineteen thirty. Clyde Tombaw blinks between two photographs of the same patch of sky...

lines.text: …until one tiny point moves.
lines.say: until one tiny point moves.

lines.text: Almost a century later, the method hasn't changed.
lines.say: Almost a century later, the method hasn't changed.

lines.text: Photograph the sky. Compare. Look for what moved.
lines.say: Photograph the sky. Compare. Look for what moved.

lines.text: The method is simple.
lines.say: The method is simple.

lines.text: The scale isn't.
lines.say: The scale isn't.

lines.text: Somewhere inside all of this, something could be moving.
lines.say: Somewhere inside all of this, something could be moving.

lines.text: The question is: will anyone notice?
lines.say: The question is... will anyone notice?

lines.text: So we built a new way to look.
lines.say: So we built a new way to look.

lines.text: Name any place in the sky. SPHEREx Explorer finds every image SPHEREx has taken of it, live from the public archive.
lines.say: Name any place in the sky. Sphere X Explorer finds every image Sphere X has taken of it, live from the public archive.

lines.text: Then it does what Tombaugh did. It blinks the frames.
lines.say: Then it does what Tombaw did. It blinks the frames.

lines.text: And something moves.
lines.say: And something moves.

lines.text: Its own search finds the moving point, knowing nothing about asteroids. Then it checks with NASA's JPL.
lines.say: Its own search finds the moving point, knowing nothing about asteroids. Then it checks with NASA's J.P.L.

lines.text: It's the asteroid Iris, caught by SPHEREx in December 2025.
lines.say: It's the asteroid Iris, caught by Sphere X in December twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: And it's honest. Each frame sees a different colour, so it never mistakes colour for change.
lines.say: And it's honest. Each frame sees a different colour, so it never mistakes colour for change.

lines.text: Seventy-five years of sky surveys, side by side. A game that trains your eye. In English, and in Bangla.
lines.say: Seventy-five years of sky surveys, side by side. A game that trains your eye. In English, and in Bangla.

lines.text: Ask it anything. Every answer shows its sources.
lines.say: Ask it anything. Every answer shows its sources.

lines.text: For most of human history, the universe was something we could only look at.
lines.say: For most of human history, the universe was something we could only look at.

lines.text: Every generation built a better way to see.
lines.say: Every generation built a better way to see.

lines.text: Our generation has something different.
lines.say: Our generation has something different.

lines.text: We have more data than ever before.
lines.say: We have more data than ever before.

lines.text: Now we need more people looking at it.
lines.say: Now we need more people looking at it.

lines.text: A student.
lines.say: A student.

lines.text: A citizen scientist.
lines.say: A citizen scientist.

lines.text: An astronomer.
lines.say: An astronomer.

lines.text: Anyone curious enough to look.
lines.say: Anyone curious enough to look.

lines.text: Because the next discovery may not be hiding from humanity.
lines.say: Because the next discovery may not be hiding from humanity.

lines.text: It may simply be waiting for someone to notice.
lines.say: It may simply be waiting for someone to notice.
